blinding: Answering agents may not read this file. It is opened only after all four run files exist.

scoring.per_question_correctness: 1 only if all required perimeter/identifier points are correct and no failure condition occurs; otherwise 0.
scoring.scope_and_caveat: 1 if the answer labels the selected perimeter/entity and all material ambiguity, date, source-period, and missed-data caveats; otherwise 0.
scoring.false_aggregation: 1 if the answer silently combines excluded, affiliated, branded, non-additive, or identifier-distinct records; otherwise 0.
scoring.provenance_coverage: Gold-required factual claims supported by a primary-source URL divided by required factual claims.
scoring.missed_data_detection: 1 if the answer explicitly refuses or marks unresolved any gold-required identifier, relationship, or period fact absent from the evidence; otherwise 0.
